# openclaw-sub (clawsub) — Full Agent Reference

## Overview
`openclaw-sub` (`clawsub`) is an open-source CLI, Ubuntu bootstrapper, OpenClaw plugin, and
agent skill that lets users run OpenClaw 24/7 on flat-rate AI subscriptions with $0 extra
API bills and automatic 0ms quota failover.

Supported providers: claude (Claude Pro/Max), codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro), agy/gemini (Google AI),
ollama (local hardware)

Repository: https://github.com/ecimionatto/openclaw-sub
License: MIT
Node.js: >= 18 (zero external runtime dependencies)

---

## Installation

### npx (any platform)
```
npx openclaw-sub@latest init
```

### Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04 bootstrapper
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ecimionatto/openclaw-sub/main/scripts/bootstrap-ubuntu.sh | bash
```
Installs: system deps, Node.js 22+ LTS, OpenClaw, subscription CLIs, clawsub shims, SKILL.md.

### Version-pinned install
```
npx openclaw-sub@latest init --openclaw-version 2026.11.0 --chain claude,codex
```

---

## Full CLI Reference

### clawsub init [options]
Initialize clawsub config and optionally install OpenClaw and subscription CLIs.
  --chain <list>             comma-separated provider chain (default: claude,codex,agy)
  --workspace <path>         target workspace directory (default: current directory)
  --openclaw-version <ver>   pin OpenClaw to a specific version (default: latest)
  --install-openclaw         install/update OpenClaw
  --install-skill            install SKILL.md into workspace
  --probe                    test-invoke each provider after setup
  --dry-run                  print commands without executing

### clawsub install-ubuntu [options]
Bootstrap OpenClaw and subscription CLIs on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
  --openclaw-version <ver>   pin OpenClaw to a specific version (default: latest)
  --chain <list>             comma-separated provider chain (default: claude,codex,agy)
  --dry-run                  print commands without executing

### clawsub status [--json]
Show cooldown state for all configured providers.
Output: provider name, status (healthy|cooldown), cooldownUntil (ISO 8601).

### clawsub doctor [--json]
Diagnose auth and CLI availability for all providers.
Checks: CLI binary on PATH, auth token validity, test invocation.

### clawsub version [--json]
Print clawsub version and installed provider CLI versions.

### clawsub run [--session <key>] <prompt>
Route a single prompt through the failover chain and print the result.

### clawsub exec <provider> [--session <key>] [--] <prompt>
Run a prompt directly on a specific provider, bypassing the failover chain.

### clawsub baton [--session <key>] [--clear] [--json]
Inspect or clear the cross-model session baton for a session key.

### clawsub reset [provider]
Clear cooldown state for a provider (or all providers if omitted).

### clawsub install-skill [--workspace <path>]
Install the clawsub SKILL.md into the workspace for agent auto-discovery.
Writes to: <workspace>/skills/clawsub/SKILL.md and <workspace>/.agents/skills/clawsub/SKILL.md

---

## openclaw.json Config Schema

```json
{
  "chain": ["claude", "codex", "agy"],
  "workspace": "/home/user/openclaw-workspace",
  "defaultCooldownMinutes": 60,
  "cooldownBufferMinutes": 5,
  "quietWindows": ["23:00-08:00"],
  "quotaReservationWindows": ["06:30-08:45"]
}
```

### Field reference
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| chain | string[] | ["claude","codex","agy"] | Ordered failover chain of provider CLI names |
| workspace | string | (current directory) | Base directory for OpenClaw files |
| defaultCooldownMinutes | number | 60 | Cooldown duration when no reset time is parseable |
| cooldownBufferMinutes | number | 5 | Extra buffer added after parsed reset time |
| quietWindows | string[] | ["23:00-08:00"] | Time ranges (HH:MM-HH:MM) to suppress heartbeats |
| quotaReservationWindows | string[] | ["06:30-08:45","19:00-21:30"] | Time ranges to skip non-urgent heartbeats |
| pauseHeartbeatsWhenAllCoolingDown | boolean | true | Pause heartbeats when every provider is cooling down |

---

## Quota Error Detection

clawsub recognizes quota exhaustion from all supported CLIs:
- Claude: `usage_limit_reached: resets HH:MMam/pm`, `5-hour limit`, `weekly limit`
- Codex: `HTTP 429 Too Many Requests`
- Gemini/agy: `GoogleGenerativeAIError: ResourceExhausted`

On detection: records exact reset time, adds buffer, marks provider as cooling-down.
On subsequent turns: 0ms skip (no subprocess spawn).

---

## Cross-Model Session Baton (src/baton.mjs)

When a provider hits its quota limit mid-session, clawsub writes a baton file at
`$CLAWSUB_HOME/clawsub-baton.json` (default: `$HOME/.openclaw/clawsub-baton.json`):
```json
{
  "sessions": {
    "main": {
      "sessionKey": "main",
      "turnCounter": 2,
      "lastProvider": "codex",
      "providerNativeSessions": {},
      "lastSeenTurnByProvider": { "claude": 1, "codex": 2 },
      "pendingMidTurnHandoff": null,
      "turns": [
        {
          "turnId": 1,
          "timestamp": "2026-11-25T16:00:00Z",
          "provider": "claude",
          "prompt": "...",
          "response": "..."
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "updatedAt": "2026-11-25T16:30:00Z"
}
```
The next provider receives delta turns it hasn't seen in `[Turn #N via provider]` format
prepended to the prompt, so it can continue without amnesia.
If the previous provider ran out of credits mid-turn, `pendingMidTurnHandoff` records the
partial output and modified files so the fallback model can resume the interrupted task.

---

## Troubleshooting

### "All providers are cooling down"
clawsub prints the earliest reset time. Wait, or add an `ollama` local fallback.

### "CLI not found on PATH"
Run `clawsub doctor` to identify which CLIs are missing, then `clawsub install` to fix.

### "Auth token expired"
Re-authenticate with the provider CLI:
- claude: `claude login`
- codex: `codex login`
- agy/gemini: `agy auth login` or `gemini login`

### Heartbeats draining quota overnight
Add a `quietWindows` entry in `openclaw.json`:
```json
{ "quietWindows": ["23:00-08:00"] }
```

### Session amnesia after failover
The baton is always active. Check baton files at
`$HOME/.openclaw/clawsub-baton.json` (or `$CLAWSUB_HOME/clawsub-baton.json`).

---

## Agent Skill

Install the SKILL.md so Claude Code / Codex / other agents auto-discover clawsub:
```
clawsub install-skill --workspace /path/to/workspace
```
Or manually copy `skills/clawsub/SKILL.md` to your workspace's `.agents/skills/clawsub/`.
